Name: Stardew Valley Money Hack for Windows Mac OS and LINUX
Author: FrodoSackins
Description:
This is a simple tool to edit the money amount in a Stardew Valley save game. 

 It's easy to use:

[list=1]
[*]Load your player XML file
[*]Enter new money amount
[*]Click set button
[*]Done!
[/list]
App is written in Java 8 using core Java and SwingUI. This is a standalone mod that does not require SMAPI.

Code is open source and available on GIT.

Git: https://github.com/michaelruiz/StardewValleyMoneyHackTool
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/enhance
